# Lemmy.ml

> > A federated link aggregator and discussion platform featuring political commentary, international news, and community-driven content with a focus on leftist perspectives and global affairs.

Lemmy.ml is an instance of Lemmy, an open-source federated alternative to Reddit. The platform hosts diverse communities discussing topics ranging from Middle East conflicts and U.S.-Cuba relations to environmental conservation, technology critique, and social justice activism.

## Key Topics

- Lemmy federated platform
- Middle East conflict (Iran, Israel, United States)
- Cuba and World Baseball Classic
- Capitalism critique and political economy
- Cross-posts from hexbear.net
- International sports and visa politics
- China trade and geopolitics
- Social media activism
- Trans healthcare advocacy
- Maritime security (Strait of Hormuz)
- Vietnam economic policy
- Environmental conservation
- Neuroscience research
- Gaming community backlash
- Gen Z political candidates

## International Politics & Conflicts

- [Trump Might Want to End the War. Iran Won't Do It on His Terms.](https://lemmy.ml/post/44310785): Analysis of U.S.-Israeli war on Iran and Trump's exit strategy challenges
- [Three more vessels hit by projectiles in Strait of Hormuz](https://lemmy.ml/post/44346077): Maritime security incident: vessels attacked in Strait of Hormuz
- [China sends humanitarian aid to Iran](https://lemmy.ml/post/44430271): China sends humanitarian aid to Iran via Red Cross organizations
- [The Vietnam-China Supply Chain Story No One Is Telling](https://lemmy.ml/post/44428054): Analysis of Vietnam-China supply chain dynamics and trade relations
